detailed_descriptions.en: Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge. Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion. Convinced that he can defeat Annihilus and save the galaxy himself, Victor Von Doom built the Cosmic Inductor, a powerful but unstable weapon threatening Earth’s safety. Make your way through Castle Doomstadt to stop Doctor Doom in our new game mode. Defeating Doom’s forces will charge up your Stabilizer, the latest creation from Reed Richards to help you stop his old nemesis’ newest plan. Gather Battery Cells to get defence, damage or tactical upgrades, choose between 12 different perks to enhance your defense, throw damage, buff your ammunition or healing faculties. Castle Doomstadt’s corridors and ramparts will offer many challenges but lots of opportunities to organize your siege. Collect powerful equipment, take on grueling challenges and help your team deal the final blow against Doctor Doom. The fate of the cosmos depends on your success: Doom is growing stronger and could become unstoppable! But maybe there is a way to rally him to your cause and join forces against Annihilus…. DLC also includes new unlockables color palettes for all playable Super Heroes and banging new tracks by Tee Lopes.
